data.gender_notes: Samaresh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sama Resh means 'Lord of Calmness' in Sanskrit and Bengali. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sama' meaning calm and 'Resh' meaning Lord. It is a name for a wise and calm-natured individual who embodies the qualities of tranquility and serenity. The name Samaresh carries the meaning “Lord of Calmness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Samaresh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of calmness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Samaresh is a name that represents inner peace and calmness. It is a name for an individual who embodies the qualities of wisdom and tranquility, and is often associated with spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Samaresh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Calmness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Samaresh total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
